chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from Suwayd al-Qalla', from Sama'ah, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): A man was seized with a woman in a house, so he confessed that she is his wife, and she confessed that he is her husband. He (peace be upon him) said: There is a man, if he were brought to me, I would accept that for him, and there is a man, if he were brought to me, I would whip him.
ai.seo_question: How does the Imam determine if a couple found together is legally married or committing adultery?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) illustrates the judicial discretion (ijtihad) of the Qadi in cases of *hadd* al-zina, where mutual confession of marriage does not automatically exempt the couple from punishment. This hadith highlights the distinction between the legal validity of the marriage contract and the evidentiary requirement of excluding the possibility of illicit relations, a key topic in Shia jurisprudence regarding the application of corporal punishment.
